turkishDelight9D.title: Turkish Delight Tour Package
turkishDelight9D.description: An unforgettable 9-day journey through Turkey's finest destinations — from the historic streets of Istanbul and Ankara, to the magical fairy chimneys of Cappadocia, the thermal cotton-castle pools of Pamukkale, and the ancient ruins of Ephesus.

itinerary.day1: Arrival in Istanbul — Airport transfer, hotel check-in in Taksim area, dinner at outside restaurant
itinerary.day2: Istanbul → Ankara — Domestic flight, Anatolian Civilizations Museum, Ankara Castle, Roman Baths, Atatürk Mausoleum, overnight in Ankara
itinerary.day3: Ankara → Cappadocia — Salt Lake & Flamingo Colony, Caravanserai, OZKONAK UNESCO Underground City, Pigeon Valley
itinerary.day4: Full Day Cappadocia — Optional Hot Air Balloon ride, Avanos Pottery experience, Pasabag & Zelve Open Air Museum, Uchisar Castle, Gala Dinner with Turkish Night Show
itinerary.day5: Cappadocia → Pamukkale — Mevlana & Whirling Dervishes Museum in Konya, evening arrival at Pamukkale
itinerary.day6: Pamukkale → Kusadasi — Hierapolis Ancient City, Thermal Travertins, Temple of Artemis (Seven Wonders), Ephesus Ancient City, House of Virgin Mary
itinerary.day7: Kusadasi → Istanbul — 6-hr scenic coach journey, Hippodrome, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, hotel check-in
itinerary.day8: Istanbul — Topkapi Palace, Grand Bazaar, Bosphorus Dinner Cruise with Show & Unlimited Local Drinks (3 hrs)
itinerary.day9: Departure — Breakfast, free time, transfer to Istanbul Airport, end of tour

includes: Arrival & Departure transfers with A/C class coach
All transportation with New Model A/C coach
1-way domestic flight Istanbul → Ankara (25 KG + 8 KG Cabin)
All entrance fees as per itinerary
All dinners at outside restaurants / hotels
Daily water bottle per person in bus
Bosphorus Dinner Cruise with Show & Unlimited Local Drinks (3 hrs)
Turkish Night Club Dinner & Show in Cappadocia
All auto parking fees & highway tolls
Room Taxes (10% + VAT for all services)
excludes: Tips: $3 per person/per day (guide) + $2 per person/per day (driver)

istanbulCappadocia7D.title: Istanbul & Cappadocia Tour
istanbulCappadocia7D.description: Discover Turkey's two most iconic destinations in 7 days — Istanbul's legendary Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia and Grand Bazaar, combined with Cappadocia's surreal fairy chimneys, underground cities and Turkish Night Club show. Optional hot air balloon ride available.

itinerary.day1: Arrival at Istanbul — Private minivan transfer to hotel in Taksim area, check-in, dinner at outside restaurant (walking distance)
itinerary.day2: Old City Tour — Hippodrome, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Grand Bazaar, lunch by own
itinerary.day3: European Side — Çamlıca Hill coffee break, Çamlıca Tower, Asian & European sides of Istanbul, Spice Market, Turkish Night Club Show with unlimited drinks
itinerary.day4: Istanbul → Cappadocia — Domestic flight (Economy 15 KG + 8 KG cabin), OZKONAK Underground City, Pigeon Valley, hotel check-in, dinner
itinerary.day5: Full Day Cappadocia — Pashabag & Zelve Open Air Museum, Avanos town & pottery ateliers, Uchisar Castle (photography), Lovers Valley
itinerary.day6: Cappadocia → Istanbul — Domestic flight back, free time for rest, dinner at Dubb Indian Bosphorus Restaurant
itinerary.day7: Departure — Breakfast, transfer to airport depending on flight time, end of tour

includes: 4 Overnights in Istanbul (Bed & Breakfast / Half Board for 5★ hotels outside Taksim)
2 Overnights in Cappadocia cave hotel (Half Board)
English speaking tour guide (subject to availability)
All entrance fees during the itinerary
Turkish Night Club Show in Istanbul with Unlimited Local Drinks (private transfers included)
2-way domestic flight Istanbul ↔ Cappadocia (20 KG + 8 KG Cabin)
All auto parking fees & highway tolls
excludes: Hot air balloon ride (optional — prices vary)
Tips: $3 per person/per day (guide) + $2 per person/per day (driver)

sevenChurches8D.title: Seven Churches of Revelation
sevenChurches8D.description: A profound spiritual journey through the Seven Churches of Revelation — walk in the footsteps of the Apostle John from Istanbul to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardes, Philadelphia and Laodicea, with Pamukkale's thermal terraces and a Bosphorus Cruise included.

itinerary.day1: Istanbul — Arrival at airport, transfer to hotel 4★/5★ upgraded, dinner at Turkish Restaurant, overnight in Istanbul
itinerary.day2: Classical Istanbul — Hippodrome, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Grand Bazaar, Bosphorus Cruise (2 hrs), dinner at outside Indian Restaurant
itinerary.day3: Smyrna & Pergamum — Domestic flight to Izmir, Smyrna ('The Suffering Church'), Pergamum ('The Compromising Church' — altar of Zeus), overnight in Izmir
itinerary.day4: Thyatira, Sardes & Philadelphia — Thyatira ('The Adulterous Church'), Sardes ('The Dead Church'), Philadelphia ('The Faithful Church'), proceed to Pamukkale
itinerary.day5: Pamukkale & Laodicea — Pamukkale Thermal Travertins, Hierapolis, Laodicea ('The Lukewarm Church'), transfer to Kusadasi
itinerary.day6: Ephesus & Kusadasi — Ephesus ('The Loveless Church'), House of Virgin Mary, Basilica of St. John, Kusadasi town & free time for shopping
itinerary.day7: Izmir Day Tour — Alexander Hill (Kadifekale), Old Jewish Quarter & Synagogue, Polycarp Church, Alsancak (Old Greek Quarter), overnight in Izmir
itinerary.day8: Departure — Free time for shopping in Izmir, transfer to Izmir Adnan Menderes Airport, domestic flight to Istanbul, connecting flight home

includes: All transportation with A/C class coaches
All museum entrance fees during the program
Lunches & Dinners at Istanbul (outside Turkish & Indian restaurants, water included)
Bosphorus Cruise (2 hrs) with private boat in Istanbul
2 Overnights in Istanbul (4★ Superior or 5★ upgraded, Bed & Breakfast)
2 Overnights in Izmir (4★ Superior, Half Board)
1 Overnight in Pamukkale (5★ Thermal Hotel upgraded, Half Board)
2 Overnights in Kusadasi (5★ upgraded, Half Board)
All lunches on route after Istanbul
All auto parking fees & highway tolls
excludes: Tips: $3 per person/per day (guide) + $2 per person/per day (driver)
